questions.q: You set `SENS_TFMINI_CFG` = 103 and typed `tfmini status` right away: the driver is not running. Why?
options: The driver needs `SER_TEL3_BAUD` = 115200, otherwise it does not start
It is started by the `rc.serial` boot script: you need a reboot
TFmini is enabled with the `SENS_EN_TFMINI` parameter, not with a port
Value 103 is GPS 2, and that port is taken
questions.explain: The port parameter is marked reboot_required: rc.serial runs the `tfmini start -d …` command at boot. The driver sets the baud rate itself (115200), there is no SENS_EN_TFMINI parameter, and 103 is TELEM 3 (GPS 2 is 202).

questions.q: `SER_TEL1_BAUD` = 57600, `MAV_0_RATE` = 0. What rate limit does the MAVLink instance get?
questions.explain: In mavlink_main.cpp, with datarate = 0 the firmware takes baudrate / 20: half the bandwidth of an 8N1 port (baud / 10 = 5760 B/s). 1200 is the MAV_0_RATE default, not the result of zero.

questions.q: Pixhawk 6X, PX4 1.17. What is wrong in this fragment?
questions.fragment:
GPS_1_CONFIG     201
GPS_2_CONFIG     202
MAV_0_CONFIG     101
MAV_1_CONFIG     102
UXRCE_DDS_CFG    102
SENS_TFMINI_CFG  103
MSP_OSD_CONFIG   401
options: `MSP_OSD_CONFIG` = 401: fmu-v6x has no such port
`GPS_2_CONFIG` = 202 conflicts with `GPS_1_CONFIG`
`MAV_1_CONFIG` and `UXRCE_DDS_CFG` both point at the TELEM 2 port
`SENS_TFMINI_CFG` = 103: TELEM 3 on this board accepts MAVLink only
questions.explain: 102 is TELEM 2, and two drivers claim it: the second one gets "Conflicting config for /dev/ttyS4" and does not start. 401 is EXT2 (the UART4 & I2C connector), 202 is a separate GPS 2 port, and TELEM 3 can go to any driver.

questions.q: An instance's stream set needs 2400 B/s of scalable messages and 21 B/s of constant-rate ones. `MAV_0_RATE` = 1200. At what rate will `ATTITUDE`, configured for 15 Hz, go out?
options: 15 Hz, the other messages are dropped
About 7.4 Hz
About 0.75 Hz
Exactly 7.5 Hz, and HEARTBEAT is halved too
questions.explain: mult = (1200 − 21) / 2400 = 0.49; 15 × 0.49 ≈ 7.4 Hz. All non-constant streams are scaled together, HEARTBEAT (const_rate) is left alone. 0.75 Hz would come from the 0.05 lower bound.

questions.q: A vehicle on 1.16 was updated to 1.17 without touching the parameters. What happened to `GPS_UBX_DYNMODEL` on the multicopter?
options: It was 6 from the airframe, now it is the default 7
It was 7, now it is 8, like on a plane
It stayed 6: the multicopter airframe still sets it
The parameter was removed; the receiver picks the model
questions.explain: In 1.15–1.16 rc.mc_defaults had `param set-default GPS_UBX_DYNMODEL 6`; in 1.17 that line is gone, so the default 7 (airborne < 2 g) applies. Only rc.fw_defaults sets 8.

questions.q: The board has an internal compass and an external one in the GPS module. You changed nothing after the first calibration. Which one is primary, and why?
options: The internal one: it is in slot 0
The one that was calibrated first
The external one: the firmware gives it priority 75 and the internal one 50
Both are averaged with equal weights while `SENS_MAG_MODE` = 1 and the calibration is fresh
questions.explain: In Magnetometer.hpp DEFAULT_EXTERNAL_PRIORITY = 75 and DEFAULT_PRIORITY = 50; the values are written to CAL_MAGn_PRIO. SENS_MAG_MODE = 1 means "publish the primary only"; there is no averaging.

questions.q: The ESCs are on DroneCAN, but the Actuators screen has no CAN output group. `UAVCAN_ENABLE` = 2. What is wrong?
options: You need `UAVCAN_SUB_ESC` = 1
Only value 3 enables ESC and servo outputs
`UAVCAN_NODE_ID` must be 0 for node ID allocation
Value 2 disables node ID allocation
questions.explain: UAVCAN_ENABLE: 1 is sensors with manual IDs, 2 sensors with dynamic node ID allocation and firmware update, 3 the same plus actuators (module.yaml: show_subgroups_if 'UAVCAN_ENABLE>=3'). There is no UAVCAN_SUB_ESC parameter, and the flight controller's node ID is 1…125.

questions.q: Pixhawk 6X, stock firmware. You want OSD over MSP to the video transmitter. What is true?
options: `msp_osd` is not in the fmu-v6x build: first make your own firmware with `boardconfig`
`msp_osd` is in the build; port `MSP_OSD_CONFIG`, the driver sets 115200
The rate comes from `SER_*_BAUD`, 57600 by default, so you must reconfigure the VTX
In 1.17 the driver sends DJI legacy MSP elements; DisplayPort comes later
questions.explain: The fmu-v6x default.px4board has CONFIG_DRIVERS_OSD_MSP_OSD=y (1.15–1.17); you need your own build for fmu-v6c, Kakute H7, Matek H743. msp_osd.cpp hard-codes B115200. DisplayPort arrived in 1.16; legacy was 1.15.

questions.q: The vehicle is disarmed. The status LED is breathing blue. What does that mean?
options: Preflight checks failed; arming is denied until you fix them in QGC
The checks passed, but there is no global position or home position
The battery is below the Low threshold
Compass calibration is in progress
questions.explain: control_status_leds: disarmed with checks passed gives BREATHE mode; the color is green only if both home and global position are valid, otherwise blue. Failed checks are a fast red blink, Low is amber.

questions.q: `CBRK_BUZZER` = 782090. What do you hear at power-on if the parameters failed to import?
options: Nothing: the buzzer is disabled entirely
The startup tune 1
The error tune 2
Tune 15 (SD_ERROR)
questions.explain: 782090 disables only the startup tune: rcS plays a tune if CBRK_BUZZER ≠ 782090 OR STARTUP_TUNE ≠ 1. On an import failure STARTUP_TUNE = 2, so the error tune plays. Full silence is 782097.
